'''Bulwark''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that joined the [[Directive 7]] movement headed by [[Mentor]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. Adopting a new name of its own choosing, Bulwark was among the droids that gathered on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zadd]] under Mentor's leadership, and was one of the few droids who were not absorbed into Mentor's consciousness. However, Bulwark was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] while trying to protect Mentor's core from invaders.

==Behind the scenes==
Bulwark appears as one of the bosses in the Flashpoint "Directive 7" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
